verdict.rationale: Treasury is an API-first product. FinancialAccounts, OutboundPayments, ReceivedDebits and Transaction ledger objects are all documented as API resources, and events like v2.money_management.transaction.created let you drive and track money movement programmatically without the Dashboard. Stripe also documents an official CLI and an MCP server for scripted and agent use. missing for 10: explicit CI/test-mode workflow documentation for Treasury, Treasury-specific CLI coverage, independent hands-on corroboration of headless/CI automation.
